items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: You played for some royalty. I was looking at your thing, the King of Morocco and the royal family of The Netherlands.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. Yeah playing with rock groups. He’s really a jazz drummer. He came up playing all kinds of jazz and he even got to play with Sam Rivers and he got to play with all kinds of people and be around people. He got to play peek-a-boo” with Dizzy Gillespie. But then he got into metal and everything, he’s doing a lot of rock, a lot of metal, and it’s taken him places I haven’t been.
You played for some royalty. I was looking at your thing, the King of Morocco and the royal family of The Netherlands.

Yeah it’s an interesting story about going to Morocco to play for the king. I was on the flight and they flew us in business class, and there were three of us sitting together. The guy next to me was from Morocco and we were speaking. And there was a guy who was with him who was just really quiet. You know he introduced me to him but he never said anything for the whole flight. And we were talking. His name was Mohammed. And we were – nice guy man, we talked the whole way man, you know, fun you know. And then we…
